messages.author: dff35b5719cbb7c3
messages.subject: Error in DIF analysis
parts:
Hello,

I am running a series of DIF analyses looking at potential DIF and DTF among a few groups (age, race, and gender). Everything is working perfectly except for one particular group where I get the error:

"Error in class(res) <- c("mirt_df", "data.frame"):
attempt to set an attribute on NULL"

I have been going over the data and I cannot for the life of me figure out what is going on.

The code I am using to do the DIF analysis is:

# Race -- Native American
  # Start by filtering the Race variable
  filter(temp, Race == "Caucasian" | Race == "Native American") -> temp_race
 
  # Separate out Grouping variable from item data
  group <- temp_race$Race
  items <- select(temp_race, -Gender, -Race, -Age_Group)
 
  # Run a model stepping down from fully constrained
  # This helps us identify which items (if any) contain DIF
  multipleGroup(items, 1, group = group, SE = TRUE, invariance = invariant_items,
                technical = list(removeEmptyRows = TRUE, NCYCLES = 1000)) -> full_constrain
 
  # Step down
  DIF(full_constrain, c("a1", "d"), scheme = "drop_sequential") -> stepdown

When I run DIF I get that error.

I have looked at the response frequencies and all categories are used
                 0          1         2         3         4          5          6 miss
Item_8  0.09957447 0.11063830 0.3880851 0.2297872 0.1174468 0.03234043 0.02212766    0
Item_72 0.02723404 0.03659574 0.2042553 0.2885106 0.2978723 0.08170213 0.06382979    0
Item_7  0.06468085 0.08425532 0.2834043 0.3063830 0.1600000 0.05787234 0.04340426    0
Item_73 0.04340426 0.06553191 0.3251064 0.2987234 0.2000000 0.03574468 0.03148936    0
Item_9  0.06978723 0.07574468 0.2885106 0.2910638 0.1753191 0.04170213 0.05787234    0

There should be sufficient n
Native American ==  1175
Caucasian == 66524


Thanks for the help in figuring out this error!
